verdict.rationale: Crossmint is fundamentally a REST API/SDK platform — wallets, payments, agent cards, checkouts, onramp/offramp are all exposed as programmatic APIs meant to be called by agents or backend code without any UI (crossmint-docs-1, crossmint-docs-7, crossmint-docs-19, crossmint-supp-4/5/6 show agents authenticating and transacting purely via API/signer keys). Agent quickstarts (crossmint-docs-2 to -6) explicitly walk through headless, non-interactive agent flows (delegated signers, x402/MPP payment clients) that are inherently CI/automation-friendly. Missing for 10: no explicit CI/CD pipeline example, dedicated server-side automation guide, or CLI/SDK reference tailored to headless test/build environments — the docs describe agent runtime usage but not automated testing/deployment workflows explicitly.
